title: Show activity markers on running command, parallel-agent and pending approval or input cards
outcome:
Extension of tm-il8n (squares at the end of the current answer) to other card types. Greg approved trying it (relayed by Termal::Scroll, mailbox #421, 03:05Z); the coordinator has not heard it directly.

PLANNED BY SCROLL, not implemented or verified yet:
- Animate only Command cards whose status is running, and parallel-agent entries that are initializing or running.
- Show a static "Waiting for you" on actionable pending approval and input cards.
- Settled and queued items stay inactive.
- Thinking, FileChanges and Diff cards have no local execution state, so no activity is inferred for them from the global session status.
- The existing text-end squares stay unchanged.

PATHS, as planned: ui/src/message-cards.tsx, ui/src/message-input-request-cards.tsx, ui/src/parallel-agents-card.tsx, ui/src/styles.css, a new ui/src/message-activity-status.tsx with tests, and possibly ui/src/MessageCard.test.tsx.
